answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent network organizes identity verification along a bonded trust trellis. Each peer must stake non-refundable collateral to broadcast any valid coordination signal, binding interaction capacity strictly to financial exposure. Honest participants extract an economic nectar through verified task execution, whereas an attacker attempting to simulate multiple nodes must fund distinct locked deposits for every persona, facing unavoidable linear capital exhaustion and immediate slashing if caught colluding.
